release_notes: Modernizes the certified Windows runtime from Python 3.12.10 to Python 3.14.7 while preserving the existing application behavior and database schema.
Updates the bundled SQLite runtime from 3.49.1 to 3.50.4 through the certified Python 3.14.7 runtime; no database schema migration is required.
Moves the Windows installer toolchain to Inno Setup 7.1.0 while preserving the existing AppId, install location and in-place upgrade path.
Keeps PySide6 and Qt at the current certified stable 6.11.2 release rather than moving to a prerelease Qt branch.
Keeps PyInstaller at 6.22.3 and retains the exact certified dependency lock used during Windows validation.
Preserves database schema 10 and the existing %LOCALAPPDATA%\Quotation Manager data location.
Preserves quotation, proforma invoice and tax invoice behavior, numbering, revision history, templates, exports and backup compatibility.
Preserves the hardened OTA transport path: Windows trust store first, certifi fallback only for certificate-chain verification failure, hostname verification and TLS 1.2+ required.
Preserves OTA installer SHA-256 and size verification, redirect restrictions, rollback protection and post-update health validation.
Restores an automatic Update Available popup when the background startup check discovers a newer release.
Queues the automatic update popup if another application modal is already open instead of stacking dialogs.
Moves update preparation progress to the global application shell so progress remains visible regardless of which page initiated the update.
Makes release notes scroll inside a bounded viewport so long changelogs cannot push the action buttons off-screen.
Keeps Later and Download & Install fixed and visible at the bottom of the update dialog while release notes scroll independently.
Restores visible Windows installer progress after the verified update download by using the Inno Setup silent UI instead of a fully hidden installer.
Keeps the Download & Install action as the user's installation confirmation without adding a redundant second confirmation prompt.
Retains the shared Sapphire/QML interaction system, modal behavior, keyboard focus handling, reduced-motion behavior and responsive editor layout from v1.2.1.
Validated on Windows with Python 3.14.7 x64, SQLite 3.50.4, PySide6/Qt 6.11.2, PyInstaller 6.22.3 and Inno Setup 7.1.0.
Product version: 1.3.0
Database schema: 10 (unchanged)
Local AppData path: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Quotation Manager (unchanged)
Installer AppId/install location: unchanged
v1.2.1/R44 is the mandatory direct rollback installer for the v1.2.1 -> v1.3.0 OTA upgrade.
